purpose: Preserve the accepted M3-C-I exact-head validation as an immutable prerequisite across M3-C-J chat, review, and operator-session changes.
non_invalidators: PR body, title, comment, review, Draft, or Ready metadata change
reporting-only reuse of this exact evidence
creation of a new descendant branch whose ancestry contains the merge SHA
invalidators: artifact loss, corruption, expiry without retained immutable copy, or SHA-256 mismatch
change to the M3-C-I implementation tree, packet digest, path digest, or storage policy
change to the validation workflow or pinned compatibility dependency
new_tree_rule: M3-C-J receives its own exact-head validation only for its actual changed tree. The M3-C-I evidence above remains reused and immutable.
next_chat_rule: Read this pin and M3_C_I_PREREQUISITE_VALIDATION_REUSE_PIN.json before scheduling validation or operator commands. Do not rerun accepted M3-C-I, M3-C-H, phone-witness, or retained-sequence evidence merely because the chat or session changed.
